## Part 1: Correlations

- Use `cor.test()` to make correlation matrices to identify correlations between variables in data

## Part 2: Multicollinearity, post-treatment bias, collider bias

- Show examples of each and how they can confound interpretations
- Show how models where causal interpretation is messed up can still do an OK job at predictions

## Part 3: Overfitting

- Show when too many variables can explain more variation but make poor predictions

## Part 4: Standardizing

- Show interpretations of models where variables are on different scales
- Show when variables are on the same scales
